notes: v1.1.112: When Facebook stops a login with 'Invalid request - We could not validate your request. Please try starting the flow from the beginning', the login no longer gets stuck. It presses OK and logs in again from the start, choosing 'Use another profile' and entering UID + password instead of the saved profile that led to the dead step; the saved profile is kept. If Facebook says it a second time, that round stops instead of looping. The same handling is in the request login's hidden-browser step. Request login now recognises a disabled account straight away (Facebook's /checkpoint/disabled after the 2FA step): status Disabled in about 13 s instead of a 3-minute browser attempt ending in a wrong 'captcha/checkpoint not passed'. Carries 1.1.111 (full bundled browser for the no-cookie Arkose solve), 1.1.110 (Login carries the account's device cookies, plain-word login progress, Warm Up picker Status filter + right-click), 1.1.109 (browser-less MetaMax-style relogin), 1.1.108, 1.1.107 and 1.1.106.
